answer: A sparrow carries one kernel across a valley only while the zephyr blows east at 12 to 18 km per hour. The bird wears a 45 dollar GPS tag logging its flight, a 90 dollar anemometer on each ridge station records the wind, and the kernel sits in a sensor bed reporting germination within 72 hours. Faking one flight takes a drone pilot at 250 dollars a day, spoofed GPS on three stations, and a greenhouse kernel for 600 dollars, 1400 dollars a fake. 100 clones cost 140000 dollars plus 90000 POA locked 45 days and 30000 POA burned per clone. A valley admits only seeds that rode the wind.
